items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: And that's right, that was his band. Those early bands we were talking about... he had Joe Welch on the drum. And I was playing penna banjo.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, uh, Joe Welch on the violin.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I was lucky enough, with Joe Welsh and Mary Monero, giving me instructions, instructions of divisions... You gotta have a teacher to do it.

ctx.x: Yeah, he'd help me. It was the main thing, but, uh, they had another fellow would help me out in that division, too. I don't know if I didn't call his name, Joe Welch.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Yeah, Joe Welch was playing drums. Oh, Joe Welch? Yeah. Joe Welch played drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, Joe Welch was playing drums. Oh, Joe Welch? Yeah. Joe Welch played drums.
I was going to ask a bit more about Galloway. Charlie Galloway, was that his name?
